title: Python: Check BLE security level before trust
description: Part of BLE LESC security check (ble)
close_reason: Implemented: BLE security level check before trust via require_lesc parameter. The BlePacketTransport now accepts require_lesc=True to reject non-LESC connections at connect time. Includes security level detection via _detect_security_level(), BleSecurityError for security failures, and tests covering all scenarios.
